limitations: Only the two declared settings and retained seeds are evidenced.
The selected production generator and canonical Racket rule remain fixed.
This extension is proposed, not catalog-approved or runtime-integrated.
Finite rival checks do not prove uniqueness against arbitrary programs.

parameter.input_constraint: every production input contains both matching and nonmatching dots, so every retained demonstration distinguishes the two settings
invariants: separator and key/source roles are unchanged
each dot is compared with its aligned key cell
dots move along their original row/column and source cells clear
only the match/mismatch branch mapped to the near edge changes
parameter.name: route_near_when
parameter.selection: one deterministic SHA-256-derived value per episode seed

match.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((global-bg (mode g))
                  (full-row (let ((rows-found (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                                  (let ((v (at g r 0)))
                                                    (and
                                                      (!= v global-bg)
                                                      (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                                               (= (at g r c) v)))))
                                                r)))
                              (if (null? rows-found) #f (first rows-found))))
                  (full-col (let ((cols-found (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                                  (let ((v (at g 0 c)))
                                                    (and
                                                      (!= v global-bg)
                                                      (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                                                               (= (at g r c) v)))))
                                                c)))
                              (if (null? cols-found) #f (first cols-found)))))
             (cond
               (full-row (let* ((sep-r full-row)
                                (src-bg (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 sep-r)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                                     (at g r c))))
                                (key-r (+ sep-r 1))
                                (near-r (- sep-r 1))
                                (far-r 0))
                           (for*/fold ((out g))
                                      ((r (range 0 sep-r)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                      (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                        (if (= v src-bg)
                                            out
                                            (let* ((key (at g key-r c))
                                                   (dest-r (if (= v key) near-r far-r))
                                                   (cleared (set-cell out r c src-bg)))
                                              (set-cell cleared dest-r c v)))))))
               (else (let* ((sep-c full-col)
                            (src-bg (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range (+ sep-c 1) w)))
                                                 (at g r c))))
                            (key-c (- sep-c 1))
                            (near-c (+ sep-c 1))
                            (far-c (- w 1)))
                       (for*/fold ((out g))
                                  ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range (+ sep-c 1) w)))
                                  (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                    (if (= v src-bg)
                                        out
                                        (let* ((key (at g r key-c))
                                               (dest-c (if (= v key) near-c far-c))
                                               (cleared (set-cell out r c src-bg)))
                                          (set-cell cleared r dest-c v))))))))))))
